candidates.change_summary: Require that msg.value is 0 instead of 1, allowing calls without sending 1 ether and thus changing stored guess state for callers.
Remove the msg.value check so callers can call with any ether amount, changing which calls succeed and thus stored state.
Set the recorded block to the current block.number instead of block.number + 1, altering the stored block value after call.
Store the guess hash as keccak256(abi.encodePacked(hash)) instead of raw hash, changing the stored guess value.
Clear any existing guess before setting new values by zeroing the struct fields first, changing observable state when reentrant or unexpected flows occur.
Change the comparison from '>' to '>=' so settle allows settling in the same block as the locked-in block number.
Zero the stored guess BEFORE computing the answer, so the comparison uses a cleared guess and prevents any win.
Compare the guess against the zero value instead of the computed answer, making success depend only on stored guess being zero.
Omit clearing the stored block (remove 'guesses[msg.sender].block = 0;'), leaving the guess record intact after settle.
